note_company: K Health (telehealth; also powers virtual-care portals for Mayo, Penn Medicine, Northwell, Hartford, Novant, Hackensack Meridian)
critical_constraints: MUST append '(h1)' to User-Agent on ALL requests (e.g. 'Mozilla/5.0 (h1)') -- required to separate hacker traffic.
HEALTH DATA -- 'search for bugs, not user data'. Endpoint-existence/status checks ONLY, never access patient data.
Register with <username>@wearehackerone.com if any account (not doing -- unauth only).
policy_notes: Takeover AND staging-env-exposure both out of scope -> our usual unauth classes largely excluded. Viable: genuine sensitive data/config exposure with impact, exposed admin panel with real access, open cloud bucket WITH data, SSRF, injection, actuator/graphql/source-leak. Deep-pass focus, no takeover.
Partner healthcare domains = high sensitivity + high dup risk; K Health's own khealth.com/khealth-test.com fresher.
